english.legislation: Contrary to article 2(6)(a) and (7) of the Heavy Commercial Vehicles in Kent (No.1) Order 2019.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being the driver of a heavy commercial vehicle
on a relevant journey in Kent
failed to comply with / contravened the request of a traffic officer
to produce a document carried on the vehicle / by the driver relating to
the vehicles journey specifically the origin / destination points of / goods to be collected / delivered on journey OR
the goods that are being exported on the vehicle from the United Kingdom to any other country
